title: Fluxion standard results report (v1)
description: Versioned, byte-deterministic standard results report emitted by the Fluxion engine (Issue #4104, closes #3988). The document is generated from the timestep-indexed end-use series (Issue #4101), the monthly end-use summaries (Issue #4102) and the unmet-hours accounting (Issue #3988/#4103) through the single `StandardReport::from_simulation` constructor, so the REST, CLI and Python surfaces emit the same document. Object keys are sorted, floats are rendered with a fixed number of decimals and zone-indexed arrays are ordered by zone index, so identical inputs yield byte-identical JSON.

monthly.description: Twelve calendar-month bins (January first), aggregated over the whole run period.

metadata.description: Document metadata block: schema/tool version, model identity and run period.

schema_version.description: Results-report schema version (semver). Minor = additive, major = breaking.

model_name.description: Name of the simulated model (e.g. 'ASHRAE 140 Case 600').

run_period.description: Simulated period description. Deterministic: no wall-clock timestamps are emitted unless the caller supplies them explicitly.

years.description: Number of simulated years covered by the report.

timesteps.description: Number of timesteps in the referenced hourly series.

start.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC start of the run period (omitted when unknown, so exports stay deterministic).

end.description: Optional ISO-8601 UTC end of the run period (omitted when unknown).

end_use_energy.description: End-use energy keyed by end use. Keys are sorted lexicographically in the serialized document.

end_use_peak.description: Peak end-use demand keyed by end use. Values are timestep-average kW.

annual.description: Annual (whole run period) summary: end-use energy, EUI and peak demand.

total_energy_kwh.description: Sum of the four end-use energies in kWh.

eui_kwh_per_m2.description: Energy use intensity in kWh per square metre of conditioned floor area.

floor_area_m2.description: Conditioned floor area in square metres used for the EUI denominator.

zone_count.description: Number of zones in the simulated model.

monthly_month.description: One calendar month of the run period.

unmet_hours.description: Unmet heating/cooling hours under both reporting conventions.

tolerance_c.description: Setpoint tolerance in degrees Celsius used for the setpoint-deviation test (0.2 C by default, EnergyPlus 'Time Setpoint Not Met' parity).

by_zone.description: Per-zone unmet hours, ordered by zone index (0-based). Empty when the run recorded no hourly zone temperature trace.

unmet_zone.description: Unmet hours for a single zone.

index.description: Zero-based zone index (zones are reported in index order).

name.description: Zone name; falls back to 'zone-<index>' when the model does not name the zone.

hourly_reference.description: Reference to the timestep-indexed end-use series. The series itself is NOT embedded in the report; the checksum lets a consumer verify the series it fetched against the report.

series_id.description: Stable identifier of the referenced series.

checksum.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical series text: end uses in heating/cooling/lighting/equipment order, timesteps in order, one fixed-precision value per line.

timesteps.description: Number of timesteps in the referenced series.

timestep_seconds.description: Timestep duration in seconds of the referenced series.

end_uses.description: End uses carried by the referenced series, in series order.

columns.description: Column names of the referenced series, in series order.
